name: Nishima Shouhei
source:
Main character of episode 2
Currently head of the vigilantes. His approval is a must regarding [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] and [url=/c92638]Aruru[/url]'s expedition into the mountain searching for [url=/c92658]Chisa[/url].
Having an arrogant personality, Nishima has always been looking down on [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] since their first encounter and refuses to give his approval. However, upon hearing [url=/c92637]Rei[/url] mentioning [url=/c92658]Chisa[/url]'s distress signal, he finally decides to support the two.
